lessons.title: Week 5 Part 1: Preparing Predictable Home Routines & Transitions
lessons.content: In Week 5 of Home Again Transition & Reunification Care, this lesson focuses on preparing predictable home routines & transitions. Parents and carers practise pausing to notice stress cues, responding with calm and predictable language, maintaining child-safe boundaries, and recording one observable example of how this skill supported their child's safety and emotional wellbeing this week.
